script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{}' --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains secrets \
  --save F08.secrets-errors/missing
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": "qa"}' --expect 422 --check detail.0.type eq dict_type
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_BAD": {"kind": "NopeSecret", "value": "x"}}}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.msg contains 'Unknown kind'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_LOOKUP": {"kind": "LookupSecret"}}}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains url
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_X": "qa-x"}}' --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID/secrets" --json '{"secrets": {"QA_F08_X": "qa-x"}}' --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID" --json '{"tags": {"qa": "f08-errors"}}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$KID" --check secret_registry.secret_sources.QA_F08_BAD missing \
  --check secret_registry.secret_sources.QA_F08_LOOKUP missing --check secret_registry.secret_sources.QA_F08_X missing \
  --check secret_registry.secret_sources.QA_F08_PLAIN exists
